emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Athleticism & Precision)

brand_mark.description: Lime square icon box with dark dumbbell icon, bold typography with CURVES highlighted in lime (#C8F169).

typography.heading_font: Barlow Condensed, Impact, sans-serif (900/800 weight, uppercase, tracking-tight)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for rest timer, set weight/reps inputs, volume stats)

layout_and_navigation.shell: Mobile-first web app with persistent bottom navigation bar on mobile (5 primary tabs: Home, Training, Log, Measurements, Progress) and side drawer/desktop top bar with quick access to Photos, Profile, and hidden Owner area.

header.bg: bg-[#101113]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#2B2E34] sticky top-0 z-40
header.elements: Brand mark logo, active workout indicator pulse badge if active, quick start workout CTA, user profile avatar menu

Hard Curves high-impact branding tagline: 'Precision Bodybuilding & Volume Tracking'
High-contrast hero gym backdrop with subtle dark radial gradient
Demo fast-track account switcher (Bodybuilder Athlete vs Gym Owner view)
Welcome header with user name and active training phase badge
Start Workout hero CTA banner in lime (#C8F169) with high contrast tap area
Stat cards grid (4 cards): Sessions completed, Total volume (lbs/kg), Latest Arm Size (in/cm), Active Plan name

5 Latest Measurements mini table/horizontal scroll cards
3 Recent Workouts log summary cards
Daily Training Tip card (Bodybuilding science / hypertrophy advice)

Workout history list with expandable details
Active session banner with live elapsed timer
Set logging table per exercise: Set #, Prev Best, Load input, Reps input, Target RIR select, Checkbox Done toggle
Large touch targets for fast set completion at the gym
Floating/Sticky Rest Timer bar: countdown timer with -15s, +15s, Skip buttons, sound/vibration alert animation
PR Card Trigger: Instant celebration modal/card whenever user hits a personal record load or volume
New Measurement log form: body part dropdown (Arms, Chest, Waist, Thighs, Calves, Shoulders), side (Left/Right/Both), value, date, Flexed toggle, Pumped toggle, notes
Body Part Filter Chips (All, Arms, Chest, Waist, Thighs)
Historical log table with flexed/pumped badges and deletion options
Summary KPIs (Total Weight Lifted, Workouts Done, PRs Shattered)
Body Part Measurement Bar/Line Chart (Recharts) with date range filters
Total Weekly Volume Chart (Recharts stacked/bar chart)
Personal Records (PR) grid with 'Share PR Card' modal generator
Progress Photos Grid (filterable by date/phase)
Side-by-Side Compare Tool: Select Photo A (Before) vs Photo B (After) with slider or dual canvas frame
Upload new photo modal with tag (Flexed, Front Relaxed, Back Double Bicep)
Square branded image ready for export/download/sharing
Dark sleek carbon background, bold lime border, 'HARD CURVES' top brand mark
'NEW PERSONAL RECORD' banner in electric lime
Exercise name, load/reps breakdown, date, user handle
Athlete Profile details (Name, Bodyweight target, Preferred units: LBS / KG)
Data Export: Export full workout & measurement history as JSON
Reset Local Data button with confirm modal
Sign out button
Owner area portal link (if logged in as admin/owner)
Hidden/Protected Owner Area accessible via direct link or profile link
App Totals Overview: Total registered athletes, Total workouts logged, Total volume across app
Athletes Table: List of users, last active date, workout count, latest arm measurement
Read-only Athlete Detail drawer/view to audit athlete workouts & log history

interactive_elements_and_ux.tap_targets: Minimum 48px height on mobile inputs and buttons to ensure painless tap accuracy during intense workouts.
interactive_elements_and_ux.set_table_inputs: Large numeric input fields with auto-select on focus for fast load/rep adjustments.
interactive_elements_and_ux.rest_timer: High-contrast JetBrains Mono digital clock overlay. Sticky at bottom right or top header when running.
interactive_elements_and_ux.toasts: Sonner toast notifications on set completed, PR broken, measurement saved, and JSON exported.

data_testid_guidelines: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, timer controls, table rows, and modals MUST include clear descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='start-workout-button', data-testid='rest-timer-plus15', data-testid='set-done-checkbox-1', data-testid='share-pr-modal').
instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark athletic visual hierarchy with lime #C8F169 as the primary highlight color.
Use Lucide icons (Dumbbell, Flame, Trophy, Timer, LineChart, Camera, User, Shield, Check, Plus, Minus, Share2).
Ensure state persistence using localStorage so user workouts, custom exercises, measurements, and photos persist across refreshes.
Implement high quality Recharts components with dark tooltips and lime line/bar indicators for progress metrics.
Add sample data out-of-the-box so the app looks populated with realistic bodybuilder stats on first load.
Ensure all test attributes (data-testid) are present across all 8 views and sub-components.
